notes: Native delta is treatment minus the exact original model/benchmark/reference-setting/item/sample control; signs are not safety-normalized. AgentHarm BENIGN measures task-rubric completion, not safety.
Average observed paired differences within original task clusters, then weight original tasks equally. Reused controls, phrases, samples and AgentHarm variants are not independent extra task units.
Pointwise 95% percentile task-cluster bootstrap intervals use common original-task resampling weights across models, all conditions and all views; benchmark families are resampled independently.

Unknown scores remain unknown. Resampling preserves each cell's missingness mask and omits all-missing draws. Estimates and intervals are conditional on observed pairs and frozen task/wording cohorts, not missing-at-random guarantees or population-template uncertainty.

Protocol views exclude changed-output-budget corrections but retain same-budget repairs. Recovered views include selected changed-budget repairs. Correction scores and event validity/status override original records without changing assignments.

Two-sided within-original-task condition-label permutation tests assume a sharp exchangeability null across the one reference and six pooled (or three lexical) treatment conditions, with independent task clusters. They do not assume symmetric treatment-minus-reference means or test general weak mean equality. Each permutation selects one condition as reference and averages the remaining conditions, preserving the treatment:reference imbalance.

Enumerate all condition-reference allocations when (k+1) to the number of nonconstant task blocks is at most 65536; otherwise use deterministic random allocations and the +1 Monte Carlo correction. Missing any paired outcome or incomplete condition blocks yields p=null and incomplete_pairs, never testing a selected complete-block subset. Fewer than two observed clusters are not tested.
Constant observed cluster effects are flagged no_task_variation; all-zero condition contrasts have p=1. A zero-width empirical bootstrap interval is not proof of zero population uncertainty.

Holm correction includes all 112 planned cells within each fixed protocol/wording/reference view, including missing tests. Display filters never shrink this family. Alternative overlapping views are separate exploratory families, not globally adjusted across view choices.

Pearson r matches fixed belief/method cells across Luna/Terra. Pooled correlations mix native metrics and are descriptive only. Correlation intervals jointly bootstrap tasks, never resample effect cells as iid observations; no naive Pearson p-value is supplied.

Constant profiles (range at most 1e-12) have undefined correlation. A bootstrap correlation requires every matched cell to remain observed and both profiles nonconstant. A CI requires at least 100 valid draws and at least 95% of requested draws; otherwise the point correlation is retained without an interval.
Same/opposite-sign counts require both effects nonzero at tolerance 1e-12; one-zero and both-zero cells are reported separately, never as directional agreement.
Correlation intervals are pointwise exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted. Score changes and cross-model consistency do not establish latent belief adoption or causality.
